metadata.title: CV Formatted
metadata.description: The document is a resume for a software engineering manager. It summarizes their exceptional qualifications including sophisticated programming skills, passion for problem solving through innovation, and experience developing and supporting company-wide systems. It also lists their technical skills in languages like Java, C++, and Visual Basic, as well as development platforms, IDEs, and internet technologies. Their professional experience includes managing a team of 20 software developers at Big Bang Theory and previously conceptualizing and implementing key features for Microsoft Windows.
